substantiveCommits.message: Bind construction metadata to sealed 4K evidence

problem: The existing strict render receipt bound native 4K pixels/crops to a capture session and the scoring path revalidated current construction/material metadata, but the exact persisted scene and metadata-contract bytes were not cryptographically tied to the same capture session. Metadata edited after capture could therefore be current-state-valid without proving it was the metadata state used by the rendered candidate.

implementation.coverageExpansion: All domains[].contractPaths from scene_metadata_coverage_contract.json are included, de-duplicated and ordinal-sorted.
implementation.hashing: SHA-256 per exact file byte stream plus deterministic SHA-256 of canonical path/file-hash pairs.
implementation.captureIdentity: Binding stores captureSessionId, exact render receipt SHA-256 and capture manifest SHA-256.
implementation.temporalSafety: A source whose filesystem last-write time is later than render-receipt sealedUtc plus 2 seconds is rejected, preventing post-capture metadata from being retroactively attached to old pixels.
implementation.mutationResponse: Editor asset-postprocess + periodic guard invalidates the authoritative render receipt and binding if any bound scene/metadata source mutates. Rendered PNGs are preserved for diagnosis but become unscoreable through the existing provenance gate.
implementation.freshAutoBind: A newly imported real render receipt can auto-bind only within 10 minutes, only with the canonical saved, non-dirty benchmark scene open, and only after current scene metadata coverage validation passes.

staticChecks: scene metadata coverage contract targets Assets/Scenes/QualityBlock1990s.unity
render receipt path matches existing provenance QA: Assets/QA/render_capture_receipt.json

failureInjectionPlan: capture and bind, then edit a linked contract: render receipt must be removed while PNGs remain
capture and bind, then save a changed QualityBlock1990s.unity: render receipt must be removed
mutate render_capture_receipt.json or captureSessionId: binding validation must fail
write metadata after render receipt sealedUtc and attempt manual binding: binding must reject it
delete or replace one coverage contract path: source-set/hash validation must fail
import an old unbound receipt: automatic guard must reject/invalidate it rather than retroactively blessing current metadata

implementationReadiness.reason: Evidence admissibility is stronger, but no Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime execution exists at this head, so readiness is not increased.

expectedImpactNotScore.pixelAppearance: none until a fresh real Unity render is observed

nextBlocker: A real Unity 6000.3.0f1 runner is required to compile the new editor QA, execute the failure-injection plan, then produce fresh 3840x2160 frontal/oblique/grazing evidence and 100% crops. No Visual Fidelity points may be awarded before that render evidence exists.
